consent.en: This profile collects publicly published VPN configurations and machine-tests them every few hours, keeping only the ones that answered. The servers are run by unknown third parties: use this for free access and unblocking, not as a privacy or security guarantee. No account, no ads, no tracking by us. Any single node may stop working at any time — if one fails, just pick the next one; the list refreshes automatically.
